title: Treasure Climb (claw challenge)
summary: The weekly points ladder (Treasure Climb): its page, (i) overlay and home bar.
description: GameCore ClawChallenge (weekly ladder, rules.json `claw`) + ClawScreen (page + (i) overlay) + ClawBar (the home bar; its frame, fill, token and flame are the home's shared event-bar chrome, EventBarChrome.swift, which Up & Away's bar and the payout draw too).

strings: Beat levels without fail to get more rewards!

notes: Kit decoupling step: the helpers every event shares are social-ui's (SocEventChrome.swift, Countdown.swift) or ui-chrome's (SocTwoLines); its closure is the events engine (inherent: its pages run the engine's flows, announcements and finish states) + social-ui + ui-chrome.
